title: The Bands of Mourning
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: The third Wax and Wayne Mistborn novel. When rumours surface that a legendary relic from the series' ancient past has been found, the lawman and his companions race to track it down before dangerous groups do.
readIf: you're following the Wax and Wayne books and want a fast, clever treasure hunt with a heist feel.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier Mistborn books, since this follows directly from them.

pairings.reason: More clever, character-driven schemes and banter, in a bleaker setting with higher stakes.
A lighter classic quest with a treasure, a ragtag crew and a pleasing sense of adventure.
Another inventive fantasy with a heist and a magic system treated like technology.
